messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: Service=edge-gateway-us-west | Metric=p99 request latency | Window=5m | Value=1.25s (>1.0s threshold) :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page triggered for escalation policy 'Realtime Inference Oncall' — incident INC-202176 | auto-page to primary oncall
sam: acked via PD. I'm on it. starting triage.
liz: thanks — pinged infra stack. preliminary dashboard shows p95 up ~600ms, p99 spike to 1.2-1.4s, error rate stable. tail seems correlated with large batched requests hitting tokenizer.
tom: seeing increased queue length on edge-proxy sidecar pods (edge-proxy-*) in us-west-2. memory ok but req-queue depth rising. suspect backpressure from tokenizer service (tokenizer-svc).
sam: grabbing runbook. first steps: 1) confirm customers impacted; 2) check autoscaler and pod restart options; 3) consider temporary traffic diversion to dedicated pool.
rachel: product here — any visible customer errors? support reported ~5 timeouts in last 10 minutes, mostly premium apps. need ETA to message customers.
liz: logs show repeated 503s from tokenizer with backpressure logs: "kv-cache: write timeout, queue_len=256". also a bump in long-tail tokenization times for long prompts.
tom: running quick curl test to tokenizers:
```
kubectl -n prod exec -it deploy/tokenizer-svc -- curl -sS -w "%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null http://localhost:8080/v1/tokenize -d '{"text": "long prompt ..."}'
```
stam: (typo) sam: executing now.
sam: result: time_total=0.18 (normal) for small prompt but 2.2s for 8k token prompt — confirms tail.
liz: mitigation proposal: 1) scale tokenizer-svc replicas from 4 -> 8 (manual scale) 2) reduce default batch_size at edge-proxy for us-west to 8 -> 4 for next 15m 3) route heavy traffic to dedicated pool redwood-dedicated-pool-3 (capacity available).
tom: scaling up tokenizer-svc: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy/tokenizer-svc --replicas=8` 
Executed — new pods coming up.
alex: I'm next-rotation oncall in 20m; will take handoff after initial work.
sam: applying temporary routing change: updating traffic-split config to divert 30% to dedicated pool for us-west.
(liz uploaded snippet) liz: traffic-split patch:
```
apiVersion: split.example.com/v1
kind: TrafficSplit
metadata:
  name: edge-gateway-us-west-split
spec:
  backends:
  - service: edge-gateway-us-west-primary
    weight: 70
  - service: edge-gateway-dedicated-pool-3
    weight: 30
```
sam: patch applied. monitoring now.
(incident-bot) incident-bot: Alert update: p99 latency reduced to 0.9s over last 3m. p95 ~350ms.
rachel: great. any customer-facing action?
liz: recommend limited customer note: short blurb about "brief increase in query latency for a subset of requests in US-West; mitigation underway; no data loss" — draft coming.
tom: tokenizer pods are Ready=6/8 now, queue depth dropping. autoscaler still ramping.
sam: will keep PD incident open for 30m observation window. alex — I'll handover if still open when you rotate in.
alex: ack — will take follow-up. if p99 stays <1s for 30m, propose close.
pagerduty: Incident INC-202176 acknowledged by sam.
(30m later) incident-bot: Follow-up: p99 stable ~0.85s, p95 320ms, error rate normal. Closing anomaly watch.
sam: closing incident on my side. filed post-incident note: investigate long-prompt batching behavior and consider throttling or prompt-size-based routing. assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime.
rachel: thanks team — I'll prep short customer note and send to comms for approval. :thumbsup:
(reacts) liz reacted with :white_check_mark:, tom reacted with :rocket:
